parts.text: I am the licensed person responsible for each flight, and I decide which drone flies and along which way before signing off a flight before it leaves. My company's policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us, though we do want help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts. My notes do not state what else must be true for me to sign off, nor do they state what I check myself that a tool could not check for me.
